input.summary: Add a mutual monetary liability cap with uncapped Excluded Claims to Section 15
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 excludes indirect damages but sets no monetary cap, so both parties' direct liability is open-ended; we have added our standard mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement remain outside the cap, and Sparkling's payment obligations are not treated as capped damages; a straight twelve months' fees cap is our fallback.

ops.oldText: The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Sparkling under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights; and Sparkling's obligation to pay fees due under this Agreement shall not be treated as damages for the purposes of this cap. The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
